body:
REQUEST CHANGES (round 1): #2597 (BUG-1994) at ddc04b1c28126054645a04bf070d16fd6d1ac41e. Fresh strict reviewer; the verdict is recorded.

The isolation itself is correct and fixes the race. Every PATH writer runs in an exact single-test child process or in a fully locked separate binary.
- Stress run (98 tests, 16 threads, 10 rounds): 8 of 10 rounds failed at the merge-base, showing the BUG-1994 signatures (git exit 127, "events differ"). At the PR head, 0 of 10 failed.
- Mutations: a raw PATH set_var and a dropped `run_path_isolated_test` call are both caught.

**B1. The stress test has a fixed time limit and runs in the default suite, so it fails on a loaded machine.**
- Where: `aida-cli-lib/src/tests/bug_1994_path_isolation_tests.rs:219-270` (watchdog at :227/:253), `history_and_path_mutators_pass_15_rounds_at_16_threads`.
- It runs in every default `cargo test --workspace` with a 120 s per-round limit. On a 6-core machine at load 18 it failed in round 2 with "stress child exceeded 120s", and no assertion failed. The standalone rounds took 78-134 s.
- It also adds about 20 minutes to every CI Build (now 28 m), and the job timeout was raised from 25 to 45 minutes to fit it.

Required fix: run the stress test as its own explicit step instead. One option is `#[ignore]` plus a dedicated `cargo test ... -- --ignored --exact <name>` step in the CI job, which still meets signoff C3. The other is to remove the fixed per-round time limit and let the job timeout be the bound. Either way, the default `cargo test --workspace` must not contain a time-limited 15-round stress loop.

Non-blocking (fix if cheap, otherwise say so in the response):
- The guardrail source scan (`tests/path_isolation_guardrail.rs:474-485`) misses a non-literal key such as `set_var(std::ffi::OsStr::new("PATH"), ..)`. It also only scans `aida-cli-lib/src`, not `aida-cli-lib/tests` or `aida-cli/tests`.
- `run_path_isolated_test` falls back to running `aida` when `current_exe` is missing. Calling `current_exe()` and failing would be stricter.
- HOME is still mutated process-wide in several unlocked places. This is the same class of hazard but out of scope, so I'm filing it as a follow-up.

Post FACTORY READY at the new head when done.
subject: #2597 BUG-1994 REQUEST CHANGES r1 (time-limited stress test in default suite)
